study: AREALS simulation efficiency across existing CFD datasets
budget_rule: ceil(T/16), ceil(T/8), ceil(T/4), ceil(T/2), T simulations, where T is the frozen number of eligible training simulations. Identical nested hashed case prefixes for both arms, independently per seed.
selection: Each training fit selects a separate checkpoint for each sensor endpoint by its matching mean validation nRMSE, every 500 updates; no test-driven checkpoint selection.
normalisation: Area-weighted training-only mean and standard deviation fitted separately for each selected subset; test target variance used only in scoring.
case_metric: Hidden-region area-weighted pressure RMSE divided by whole-case area-weighted pressure standard deviation; mean over test simulation cases.
uncertainty: 5,000 paired bootstrap draws over downstream seeds and physical test geometry groups. All conditions in a sampled geometry group stay together. Report pointwise intervals and three seed means.
threshold_estimator: Smallest measured budget crossing the fixed target. No interpolation or extrapolation; right-censor missing crossings at the maximum tested budget.
